scope: Publication proposal from the 184 existing HBS profiles captured October 11-12, 2026; no new faculty or non-HBS records.
policy: Keep source-supported research articles and explicitly identified research working papers; working papers are not treated as accepted or peer-reviewed journal publications.
Exclude management-practice journals, commentary, book reviews, teaching material, appendices and editorial introductions.
Defer ambiguous genres and unresolved later-version/title overlaps individually.
Keep all existing source papers and non-HBS records; no blanket status/metadata refresh.
Website journal matching must not introduce unreviewed publications as a side effect.
limitations: Bibliographic and genre review is not a scientific validity or full-text review of every paper.
All working-paper years and statuses reflect the captured official HBS citation; older papers can have unidentified later versions.
Existing upstream non-research publications are not removed in this import.
Existing-corpus DOI variants are retained unless explicitly corrected in this review; this is not a global corpus cleanup.
